av_event.line_text: Erm. I saw your PlayStation in your photo. What do you play?
av_event.what: The ginger cat jumps up from the sofa arm onto the table and walks right in front of the laptop. For a second or two its body and tail block most of the webcam view of Bethany's face, and then it steps out of frame to the right.

text:
A: Hi. Erm, hi, can you hear me okay?
B: Yeah. Alright.
A: I'm Bethany.
B: Callum.
A: Erm, where are you?
B: Swindon.
A: Oh, okay. I'm in Basingstoke, so not that far, sort of.
B: Yeah.
A: Yeah. Erm. Sorry, I'm not very good at starting these. Are you working, or...?
B: Not at the minute. I got made redundant from a sports shop, I was assistant manager. Applying for stuff now. So, yeah.
A: Oh, sorry. That's rubbish. What sort of stuff are you applying for?
B: Warehouse, supervisor, that sort of thing. The bloke on my last call reckons I should change my CV and make it less retail. Which, yeah, probably. I just haven't done it.
A: Less retail, yeah. I sort of know that feeling. I've been about to start an Azure course for, like, six months.
B: What's that?
A: Erm, it's Microsoft cloud stuff. I work on an IT service desk, second-line, at an insurance company. People ring when they're locked out, or Outlook's broken, and I fix it. I'd quite like something more behind the scenes eventually, less on the phones. But then I'd have to actually do the course, so. I don't know.
B: Yeah.
A: Yeah. That's sort of it really.
B: I had loads of people kicking off at the shop. Refunds, mostly. You just let them go till they run out of steam.
A: Yeah, that's exactly it. If you stay calm they calm down, mostly. Some of them just want someone to listen to them for a minute, I think.
B: Yeah.
A: Erm. I saw your PlayStation in your photo. What do you play?
B: EA FC, Call of Duty. My controller's drifting though, so I keep dying in Call of Duty because it just walks off on its own. Need a new one, but they're like seventy quid.
A: Seventy? Wow. I mostly play Stardew Valley, and Animal Crossing. So, not quite the same.
B: My girlfriend played Animal Crossing loads in lockdown. Proper into it. She had me watering her flowers while she was at work.
A: Aw, that's really nice though. Did you get into it?
B: A bit. I paid off her house loan once. And the turnip stuff. She was well chuffed. Then I went back to Call of Duty, so.
A: Oh, the turnips. I lost so much on turnips.
B: Yeah, she's a scammer, that pig.
A: Daisy Mae, yeah. Erm, do you do anything else, like outside?
B: Walks at Coate Water sometimes, when Jess makes me. That's it really.
A: I do the canal path at weekends. And I keep restarting Couch to 5K. I've done week three about four times now.
B: Four times, fair play. I wouldn't get to week one.
A: Week one's alright, honestly. It's week three that's—
